verdict.rationale: AWS publishes official open-source MCP servers under the awslabs GitHub organization, and a probe confirms an official MCP server is documented there, so an agent can connect to AWS through first-party MCP tooling. The evidence is only a title-level mention and a probe, with no detail on setup, the services covered, auth, or transports. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on connecting an agent (configuration, auth, supported services/tools), hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
